Closing by operator decision (2026-08-06). Eight of nine acceptance criteria verified on current main and ticked; the ninth is NOT satisfied and is recorded here so the gap is not lost.

VERIFIED (ticked):
- ONE pure classifier, TWO consumers: classify(local, jira, binding, baseline) at src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/classify.py:132. Live pass ACTS on it (binding_walk.py:196,230); audit REPORTS it (_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py:258, reconcile_check.py:340).
- Offline audit flags the required cells: local_gone, retired_overlap, unbound_jira, dangling buckets present (bridge_fsck.py:228-244).
- bridge-fsck gained the bindings.json-aware check (audit_binding_drift).
- READ-ONLY on bindings.json; L9 audit boundary documented at bridge_fsck.py:258. No write/save/dump call in the module.
- Offline/online split done: reconcile_check's orphaned-bindings and unbound-Jira detectors delegate to classify() (reconcile_check.py:68, 325-340).
- Dead bridge_fsck.enumerate_* enumerators removed (commit 381f6bb9d5a); zero matches remain.
- RED test passing: tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_fsck_binding_drift.py::test_confirmed_404_state_sources_dangling; full file 12 passed.

NOT SATISFIED (left unticked):
- 'Report mode is the PARITY ORACLE ... wire it to alert (open a ticket) on unhealed drift.' file_conflict_bug_ticket exists at rebar_reconciler/conflict_bug_filing.py:115, but NOTHING wires binding drift to it — no reference from bridge_fsck.py or binding_walk.py. Detection is done; alerting is not. That wiring is the residual work and is not tracked elsewhere as of this close.
